body.purpose: Prose and all running text. Max measure 58 to 62ch.

handwriting.purpose: Margin notes and annotation marks only. Never information.

label.purpose: Section labels, board coordinates, ADR ids. Never decorative.

title.purpose: Project and role names. The heaviest text on the page.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color state changes on controls and links.

motion.name: draw-in
motion.purpose: Hand-drawn bracket or arrow stroke animation, once, reduced-motion safe.

motion.name: logo-raise

components.name: Icon button (theme toggle)
components.description: Outline icon button, 40 by 40px, 8px radius. Used for the theme toggle with a Switch to dark or light theme label.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Switch to dark theme"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14.3 10.8 A6.1 6.1 0 0 1 7.2 3.7 A6.1 6.1 0 1 0 14.3 10.8 Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); background: var(--bg); border-radius: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-2); transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-icon-button:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--hairline-2); background: var(--surface); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Board toggle
components.description: Segmented control for the As White and As Black chess diagrams. Buttons carry aria-pressed and are 40px tall.
components.css: .ds-board-toggle { display: flex; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-board-toggle button { appearance: none; border: none; background: transparent; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 40px; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-board-toggle button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); outline: 1px solid var(--hairline-2); } .ds-board-toggle button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project row
components.description: Text row with a 40px logo tile, name, one-liner, domain line, and a handwritten annotation mark. Expands in place with a native details element.
components.html:
PRISMPayment reconciliation that turns four disagreeing signals into explainable findings.Distributed systems, Data ingestion!

Independent payment reconciliation for Flutterwave and Paystack.
components.css: .ds-project { border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .ds-project-summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 16px 8px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-project-logo { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-project-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: block; } .ds-project-oneliner { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); line-height: 1.55; } .ds-project-domains { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-annotation-mark { font-family: var(--font-hand); font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; color: var(--pen); } .ds-project-detail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 18px; padding: 4px 8px 32px; } .ds-project-summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Margin note
components.description: Handwritten note in Pen Ink with a hand-drawn bracket that draws itself in once when scrolled into view. Hangs in a right gutter at 1260px and wider, drops under its target below.
components.html: position before material
components.css: .ds-margin-note { font-family: var(--font-hand); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--pen); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 240px; } .ds-margin-note .ds-note-bracket path { stroke-dasharray: 220; stroke-dashoffset: 220; } .ds-margin-note.drawn .ds-note-bracket path { animation: ds-draw-in 600ms ease-out forwards; } @keyframes ds-draw-in { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-margin-note .ds-note-bracket path { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

components.name: Chessboard
components.description: 160px SVG board rendered from a FEN string by a hand-written parser. Alternating Surface squares, Ink border, glyph pieces, Mono rank and file labels.
components.html: <svg class="ds-chess-board" width="160" height="160" viewBox="0 0 160 160" role="img" aria-label="Chess diagram"><rect width="160" height="160" fill="var(--surface)"/><rect x="20" y="0" width="20" height="20" fill="var(--surface-2)"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-chess-board { border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-board-ranks, .ds-board-files { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-piece { font-family: var(--font-chess); font-size: 15px; fill: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview: This is a page from the notebook of an engineer who also plays chess: a single column of ink on white paper, and the same page under a lamp in dark mode. The only expressive devices are three small ones, used sparingly: handwritten margin notes in blue pen ink with a hand-drawn bracket or arrow, chess annotation marks beside projects, and link underlines that draw in like a pen stroke on hover. Everything else is plain: hairline dividers, small muted section labels, text rows instead of cards.
keyCharacteristics: One centered column, 720px maximum, on white paper or lamp-lit near-black
Flat surfaces only; hairlines carry structure
Handwriting only for margin notes and annotation marks, never for information
Sentence case everywhere, including section labels
Nothing here is decorative chrome; every row is a reader's choice

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pen ink is the only saturated color on the page. Achieving emphasis any other way (cards, shadows, gradients, badges) is a defect, not a style choice.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: No gradients, drop shadows, glassmorphism, or blur anywhere. Depth is conveyed by hairlines and surface tones, never by light.

rules.name: The Handwriting Only Rule
rules.body: Caveat never carries body text, essential information, or more than one or two notes per screenful. It is annotation, not information.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set in title case or all caps. Section labels are small, muted, and sentence case.

rules.name: The No Light Rule
rules.body: Any box-shadow, gradient, or backdrop-filter reaching this surface is a category reflex, not a design decision. Reject it.

dos: Do reference tokens (--bg, --surface, --ink, --pen), never raw hex, in components.
Do keep the measure narrow and the whitespace generous.
Do keep handwriting to margin notes and annotation marks only.
Do verify contrast for every text token on every background in both themes.
Do keep interactive targets at 40px or larger on mobile.
Do check for horizontal overflow at 375, 768, 1100, and 1440px.
donts: Don't add cards, stat counters, skill tag lists, tabs, or filter bars.
Don't use gradients, shadows, glassmorphism, or blur.
Don't set eyebrow kickers or numbered section headers; the label carries its own weight.
Don't use em-dashes, en-dashes, or emojis anywhere in copy, comments, commits, or metadata.
Don't invent facts or metrics; unknown values are TODOs in the data file and the page renders gracefully without them.
Don't copy the layout of another portfolio; the structural devices (the board, the annotations, the ADR notes) are deliberately unlike the reference that inspired the mood.
Don't remove the legacy-domain redirect from index.html without a plan for the old address.
